name: Card
description: A card groups content and actions about one subject, such as an article, a product or a person, into a single container. It can hold media, a title, text and actions, and can link to a detail page.
whenToUse: To show a collection of similar items people scan and compare, e.g. products or articles in a grid.
To group a summary and its actions, linking to a detail page.

whenNotToUse.text: To lay out a whole page section.
For rows of data people compare column by column.
For a single message or status.

anatomy.name: Container
anatomy.description: Background, corners (radius theme) and shadow (shadow theme).

anatomy.name: Media
anatomy.description: Optional image; the theme’s placeholder shows without one.

anatomy.name: Title
anatomy.description: Names the subject; becomes the link in a clickable card.

values.meaning: Shadow from the shadow theme. Default on page backgrounds.
Border instead of shadow, for dense layouts and flat themes.
Tinted background, for grouping inside another surface.
Media above the body. Default for grids.
Media beside the body, for lists.

states.name: Hover
states.meaning: A clickable card highlights its border.

states.name: Focus
states.meaning: The whole card shows the focus ring when its link has focus.

behavior.text: With href, the title becomes the link and its hit area stretches over the card: one link, one Tab stop, a sensible screen reader name.
Buttons in CardFooter stay clickable and separate from the card link.
Pick the CardTitle level (as) that fits the page outline; default h3.
Corners follow the radius theme, the elevated shadow the shadow theme, colors brand and mode.

content: Keep titles short and front-load the important words.
Keep descriptions to one or two lines in grids so cards stay the same height.

guidelines.do: Make the whole card clickable with href when it leads to one place.
guidelines.dont: Nest several links that all go to the same page.
guidelines.why: Repeated links add Tab stops and noise for screen readers.

guidelines.do: Keep cards in a grid consistent: same parts, same order.
guidelines.dont: Mix cards with and without media in one row.
guidelines.why: Consistent cards are easier to scan and compare.

guidelines.do: Use outlined cards when the shadow theme is flat.
guidelines.dont: Place flat, borderless cards on a background of the same color.
guidelines.why: Without a shadow or border the card’s edges disappear.

accessibility.role: article by default (or the element you choose with as).

keyboard.action: Reaches the card link (with href) and any footer actions.

aria.when: The heading and link give the card its name.

accessibility.focus: In a clickable card, the focus ring surrounds the whole card.

wcag.how: Cards use real headings and an article element.
The card link is named by its title.

notes: Avoid making a card clickable and also putting other links in its body.

examples.title: Article card
examples.code:
import { Card, CardMedia, CardBody, CardTitle, CardDescription } from '@ds/react';

<Card>
  <CardMedia src="/covers/tokens.png" alt="" />
  <CardBody>
    <CardTitle>Design tokens in practice</CardTitle>
    <CardDescription>How one CSS file themes three brands.</CardDescription>
  </CardBody>
</Card>

examples.title: Clickable card
examples.description: The whole card links to the article.
examples.code:
import { Card, CardBody, CardTitle, CardDescription } from '@ds/react';

<Card href="/articles/tokens" appearance="outlined">
  <CardBody>
    <CardTitle>Design tokens in practice</CardTitle>
    <CardDescription>8 min read</CardDescription>
  </CardBody>
</Card>

examples.title: With actions
examples.description: Footer actions stay separate from the card.
examples.code:
import { Card, CardBody, CardTitle, CardFooter, Button } from '@ds/react';

<Card>
  <CardBody>
    <CardTitle>Pro plan</CardTitle>
  </CardBody>
  <CardFooter>
    <Button size="small">Upgrade</Button>
  </CardFooter>
</Card>

related.relation: Pattern for products, built from Card.

changes: Card is now a generic container (media, body, title, description, footer) with appearances and orientations.
The product layout moved to ProductCard; the brand prop and its hard-coded colors were removed (use ThemeProvider).

components.name: Card
components.description:
A container that groups related content and actions about one subject, such as a product,
an article or a person.

appearance.description:
`elevated` (default) lifts the card with the shadow theme, `outlined` draws a border for
dense layouts, `filled` tints it for grouping inside a surface.

orientation.description: `vertical` stacks media above the body; `horizontal` puts media beside it.

href.description:
Makes the whole card a link to this URL. The CardTitle becomes the link, and its hit area
covers the card, so there's one clear, accessible target.

as.description: Element to render: `article` (default) for standalone content, `div` or `li` otherwise.

components.name: CardMedia
components.description: An image at the top (or side) of the card. Without src, the theme's placeholder shows.

alt.description:
Describes the image. Use an empty string when the image is decorative, e.g. when the
title already says what it shows.

components.name: CardTitle
components.description: The card's heading. In a card with href, it is the link.

as.description: Heading level that fits the page outline. Default h3.

components.name: CardFooter
components.description: Actions or metadata at the bottom of the card. Buttons here stay clickable in link cards.
